name: Minecraft Modpack (CurseForge / Modrinth)
author: noreply@example.com
description: Installs a Minecraft modpack straight from Modrinth, CurseForge or a direct link, including the mod loader (Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge). Set the source and the pack's slug, install, accept the EULA, start. No Panel extension needed.

variables.name: Modpack source
variables.description: Where the pack comes from: modrinth, curseforge, or url (a direct https link to a .mrpack or a server-pack .zip). CurseForge needs an API key configured by the administrator.

variables.name: Modpack ID
variables.description: Modrinth: the project slug (modrinth.com/modpack/<slug>). CurseForge: the slug (curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/<slug>) or numeric project id. url: the https link.

variables.name: Modpack version
variables.description: Optional. Modrinth: version number or id. CurseForge: file id. Empty = newest release.

variables.name: Minecraft version filter
variables.description: Optional. When the version above is empty, only consider pack versions for this Minecraft version (for example 1.20.1).

variables.name: Extra Java flags
variables.description: Garbage-collector and tuning flags added to the start command. The heap is set to 80% of the server's memory automatically.

variables.name: CurseForge API key
variables.description: Set by the administrator (./ptero egg install). Hidden from server owners. Note: every egg variable is also in the game process's environment, so use a dedicated, low-privilege key.
